fields.description: Portal login user (Website User) that will access the Vendor Dashboard for this site.
fields.label: Vendor User

fields.description: While off, the captive portal shows a maintenance message instead of the STK push flow. Voucher redemption and Lipa Namba are unaffected.
fields.label: Enable Online Payment (Mobile Money)

fields.description: Shows a one-time free-trial button on the captive portal. Each device (by MAC address) can only claim it once per site -- claiming again is blocked automatically once used.
fields.label: Enable Free Trial

fields.description: How long a first-time device gets connected for free before it's disconnected. The device's MAC is then registered so it cannot claim the free trial again.
fields.label: Free Trial Duration (Minutes)

fields.description: MAC address of the Access Point used to match incoming captive portal redirects.
fields.label: AP MAC Address

fields.description: How this site authorizes a client after payment/voucher success. "Omada Controller API" (default, existing behavior) calls the Omada SDN Controller's REST API -- requires a Controller (software, OC200, or Omada Cloud) managing the AP. "Local RADIUS Server" is for standalone EAPs with no Controller: the EAP is set to Authentication Type "External RADIUS Server" and validates logins against foh_ms's own independent RADIUS server (see foh_ms.radius_server) instead.
fields.label: Authorization Method
fields.options:
Omada Controller API
Local RADIUS Server

fields.description: For a local/self-hosted Controller: its LAN IP. For an Omada Cloud-managed site: the cloud API host shown in the browser URL when you're on the controller's dashboard, e.g. "euw1-omada-cloud.tplinkcloud.com".
fields.label: Controller IP / Host

fields.description: 443 for Omada Cloud (HTTPS default); 8043 for a local Controller's default HTTPS management port.
fields.label: Controller Port

fields.description: The CONTROLLER_ID path segment TP-Link's External Portal API requires (also called Omadac ID) -- distinct from the Site ID below. Find it via the controller's Open API app registration page, or in Settings > Platform Integration.
fields.label: Controller ID

fields.description: Once a client is authorized on the Omada controller, the portal page redirects the browser here to break it out of the captive portal.
fields.label: Success Redirect URL

fields.description: IP address the EAP itself sends RADIUS requests from (its management/LAN IP) -- must match "RADIUS Server IP" reachability on the EAP's Portal page and is used here to look up the correct shared secret for incoming requests.
fields.label: EAP IP Address

fields.description: Must match the "NAS ID" field configured on the EAP's Portal page.
fields.label: RADIUS NAS Identifier

fields.description: Shared secret -- must match "RADIUS Password" configured on the EAP's Portal page exactly.
fields.label: RADIUS Shared Secret

fields.description: Template for the URL the portal page must send the client's browser to once payment/voucher succeeds, so the EAP performs the RADIUS login itself. Placeholders: {username} {password} {client_mac} {ap_mac}. This has NOT been verified against real TP-Link standalone EAP firmware -- confirm the correct login endpoint/parameters for your exact model before relying on it (e.g. by inspecting what the EAP's own Local Web Portal with Username/Password submits), then fill this in.
fields.label: AP Login Redirect URL Template

fields.description: Extra Access Points whose captive-portal traffic and voucher redemptions should also count toward this site -- the AP MAC Address field above remains this site's primary device.
fields.label: Additional Devices

fields.description: Shown in place of the default WiFi mark on this site's captive portal. Also editable live from the mobile app's Customize Portal screen.
fields.label: Portal Logo

fields.description: Overrides the default "Premium WiFi Access" line on the captive portal. Leave blank to keep the default (translated EN/SW).
fields.label: Portal Tagline

fields.description: Captive portal's primary accent color.
fields.label: Portal Primary Color

fields.description: Captive portal's secondary accent color.
fields.label: Portal Secondary Color

fields.description: Manual pay-by-QR/till-number images offered from the captive portal's Lipa Namba button. Add one per network; if more than one, the customer is asked to pick a network first.
fields.label: Lipa Namba Images
